description: This file defines the SimpleGeneratorOptions class responsible for configuring a stream generator in Orleans. It sets properties such as stream namespace, generator type, and number of events to generate.

classes.name: SimpleGeneratorOptions
classes.description: A configuration class for setting options of the SimpleGenerator stream provider, including namespace, generator type, and event count.

methods.name: StreamGeneratorType
methods.description: Returns the Type object for the SimpleGenerator class, indicating the generator type used.
